Ammo.name: ClipAmmo
Ammo.description: Number of bullets in a clip

Ammo.name: SpareAmmo
Ammo.description: Spare ammo carried by each vehicle (normally all vehicles have 10000)

Reloading & Firing.name: ReloadSingle
Reloading & Firing.description: Whether bullets are reloaded one at a time

Reloading & Firing.name: ReloadApplicationProportion
Reloading & Firing.description: Proportion through the reload that the actual reload occurs

Reloading & Firing.name: BurstShotCount
Reloading & Firing.description: Number of bullets fired in a single burst

Damage & Impact.name: Damage
Damage & Impact.description: Damage the weapon does, before considering multipliers, falloff etc.

Damage & Impact.name: DirectHitMultiplier
Damage & Impact.description: Damage multiplier to apply to the damage done on a direct hit

Damage & Impact.name: EnergyDrain
Damage & Impact.description: Amount of energy to drain from targets

Damage & Impact.name: DamageAgainstArmorMultiplier
Damage & Impact.description: Multiplier for damage against armoured targets

Damage & Impact.name: DamageAgainstGeneratorMultiplier
Damage & Impact.description: Multiplier for damage against generators

Damage & Impact.name: DamageAgainstBaseTurretMultiplier
Damage & Impact.description: Multiplier for damage against base turrets

Damage & Impact.name: DamageAgainstBaseSensorMultiplier
Damage & Impact.description: Multiplier for damage against sensors

Damage & Impact.name: DamageAgainstGravCycleMultiplier
Damage & Impact.description: Multiplier for damage against Grav Cycles

Damage & Impact.name: DamageAgainstBeowulfMultiplier
Damage & Impact.description: Multiplier for damage against Beowulfs

Damage & Impact.name: DamageAgainstShrikeMultiplier
Damage & Impact.description: Multiplier for damage against Shrikes

Damage & Impact.name: ImpactMomentum
Damage & Impact.description: Amount of momentum applied to a player hit by this weapon

Damage & Impact.name: ExplosiveRadius
Damage & Impact.description: Size of the weapon's damaging explosion

Damage & Impact.name: BulletDamageRange
Damage & Impact.description: Size of the damage range (not the total range of the weapon)

Damage & Impact.name: MaxDamageRangeProportion
Damage & Impact.description: Proportion of the damage range at which falloff starts

Damage & Impact.name: MinDamageRangeProportion
Damage & Impact.description: Proportion of the damage range at which falloff ends

Damage & Impact.name: MinDamageProportion
Damage & Impact.description: Proportion of the normal damage dealt at the MinDamageRangeProportion

Damage & Impact.name: DoesImpulseFlag
Damage & Impact.description: Whether the weapon's explosion pushes the flag around

Damage & Impact.name: DoesGibOnKill
Damage & Impact.description: Whether this weapon will cause a killed enemy to explode into pieces

Damage & Impact.name: GibImpulseRadius
Damage & Impact.description: Radius for which gibbing impulse is applied to pieces of deceased enemy

Damage & Impact.name: GibStrength
Damage & Impact.description: Momentum applied to gibbed pieces of an enemy

Projectiles.name: ProjectileMaxSpeed
Projectiles.description: Cap on the absolute projectile speed, regardless of inheritance

Projectiles.name: CollisionSize
Projectiles.description: Radius of the projectile's collision sphere

Projectiles.name: ProjectileInheritance
Projectiles.description: Proportion of the shooter's velocity the projectile inherits

Projectiles.name: ProjectileLifespan
Projectiles.description: How long the projectile travels for before exploding in midair

Projectiles.name: ProjectileGravity
Projectiles.description: Multiplier by which gravity affects the projectile

Accuracy.name: Accuracy
Accuracy.description: Proportion of accuracy for the weapon's shot

Accuracy.name: AccuracyLossMax
Accuracy.description: Maximum decrease in accuracy at a given time

Accuracy.name: AccuracyCorrectionRate
Accuracy.description: Rate at which accuracy returns after decreasing
